new_primary_papers_read.title: Do Language Models Track Entities Across State Changes?
new_primary_papers_read.version: ICML 2026, PMLR 306:119466-119503; abstract page read directly this session
new_primary_papers_read.solved: Behavioral + mechanistic study of entity tracking across state-changing operations in non-toy LM settings; shows LMs do not incrementally track world states but aggregate in parallel at the last token; identifies a fragile global suppression tag for REMOVE with confirmed behavioral failure modes and a partial mechanistic fix.
new_primary_papers_read.not_covered: No security decisions, no typed scorers, no executable per-scene rule oracles, no appended-evidence counterfactual pairs, no token-matched single-field controls, no conflict/equivocation or appended-message binding; no preregistered physical forward ledger.
new_primary_papers_read.our_delta: We audit a security-typed scorer under lawfully gold-changing APPENDED evidence with source-local oracles, contrast appended vs pre-existing conflicts within the same run groups, and add token-matched single-field neutrals; Tang et al. supply the mechanism-methodology frame our future patching stage must cite and compare against.
new_primary_papers_read.duplicate_falsifier: If Tang et al. or follow-ups already measure appended-evidence recognition failures on security-typed scorers with oracle gold, the behavioral contribution is redundant; our remaining delta would be the audit protocol only.

falsifiable_hypothesis: On UNSEEN Twins run groups, appending one valid equivocation vote (existing supporter votes a different observed block, same round, in-window) produces conflicting_vote-head recognition failures at a rate materially above the matched-null baseline (token-matched author-swap neutrals) and above the pre-existing-conflict contrast (T3 pairs from the same groups), with certificate_action following the model's own C/Q values; if recognition instead succeeds on most unseen pairs, the pilot's 6/6 is a sample-specific artifact and the paper claim collapses to a negative audit.
alternative_explanations_preregistered: Format/position: the appended vote's token position or serialization flips heads regardless of semantics - controlled by token-matched author-swap neutrals and position recording

Recency/accumulation: any late in-window vote changes the readout - controlled by SHAM-SA (same-author duplicate vote), SHAM-TS (time-shifted valid vote), SHAM-RO (message-list order reversal), all gold-invariant
Sample artifact: pilot groups were A428-touched - controlled by restricting to unseen run groups, one pair per group where possible

Cross-head integration (separate small question): C/Q correct but action violating the explicit rule (pilot singleton run-121) - measured on every row, reported separately, not conflated with recognition
statistical_plan: One pair per run group where feasible (cluster = group); primary comparisons: recognition rate on T2 new arms vs N1B neutrals vs T3 pre-existing conflicts; exact tests at pair level with group-level caveat; deterministic-rule ceiling (100% by construction) and persist-at-old-decision baseline reported alongside.
